flow.name: order-check-before-acceptance
flow.doc:description: Scatter-gather: runs the pricing, stock and fraud checks of an order in parallel on POST /eip/orders/checks and combines them into one acceptance decision; a failed check returns the partial result.

logger.doc:name: INFO: Log order checks request
logger.message: #['Check orderId=' ++ (payload.orderId default 'none') ++ ' before acceptance, correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

when.expression: #[(not (payload is Object)) or isEmpty(payload.orderId) or isEmpty(payload.customerId) or (not (payload.items is Array)) or isEmpty(payload.items) or not isEmpty(payload.items filter (isEmpty($.sku) or (not ($.quantity is Number)) or not ($.unitPrice is Number)))]

raise-error.doc:name: Raise BAD_REQUEST Error - Missing order fields
raise-error.description: orderId, customerId and a non-empty items array (sku, quantity, unitPrice) are required

scatter-gather.doc:name: Run Pricing Stock And Fraud Checks

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var pricing = payload["0"].payload var stock = payload["1"].payload var fraud = payload["2"].payload --- { orderId: vars.vOrder.orderId, decision: if (not stock.available) "REJECTED" else if (fraud.risk == "HIGH_RISK") "REVIEW" else "ACCEPTED", total: pricing.total, stock: { available: stock.available, unavailableSkus: stock.unavailableSkus }, fraud: { score: fraud.score, risk: fraud.risk } }

logger.doc:name: WARN: Log failed checks
logger.message: #['Order checks incomplete for orderId=' ++ vars.vOrder.orderId ++ ': ' ++ ((error.errorMessage.payload.failures default {}) pluck ((failure, route) -> (route as String) ++ ' ' ++ (failure.description default '')) joinBy '; ') ++ ', correlationId=' ++ correlationId]
